name: skim
description: Read public pages and PDFs, extract data, crawl sites, create page watches, and read Signals through skim402.com. Sends requested URLs and options to Skim and consumes your plan credits. Bundled local server; API key required; no wallet access.

skim_api_key.title: Skim API key
skim_api_key.description: Your sk402_ key from skim402.com/pricing. Tool calls consume plan credits and may incur overage charges if enabled on your plan. Do not enter a wallet private key.
